operations.name: run

summary.en: Run one task of one project.
summary.de: Führt eine Task eines Projekts aus.

description.en: Run the serve task with the default implementation.
description.de: Führt die Serve-Task mit der Standardimplementierung aus.

description.en: Run the same task with Bazel.
description.de: Führt dieselbe Task mit Bazel aus.

description.en: Print the task graph and run nothing.
description.de: Gibt den Task-Graphen aus und führt nichts aus.

notes: --dry-run prints a DryRunPlan on stdout and executes nothing; --graph is the same flag for every tool and takes an optional file.

Bazel: a selection builds exactly the transitive closure of its tasks in one generated workspace; a cached test-family task without declared outputs and without dependents runs as a Bazel test (cached test results, --build_tests_only when only tests are selected, --nocache_test_results with --skip-cache), every other task as a cacheable build action. Test sharding is not offered because the neutral contract defines no shard protocol.

operations.name: affected

summary.en: Run targets in the projects changed against HEAD and their dependents.
summary.de: Führt Targets in den gegenüber HEAD geänderten Projekten und deren Abhängigen aus.

description.en: Test what changed against HEAD plus untracked files.
description.de: Testet, was sich gegenüber HEAD geändert hat, plus unverfolgte Dateien.

description.en: Build what differs between two revisions.
description.de: Baut, was sich zwischen zwei Revisionen unterscheidet.

notes: Changed files: tracked changes against HEAD plus untracked files by default; --base/--head, --files, --uncommitted and --untracked narrow them; --all selects every project.

Nx translation: no selector adds --base=HEAD, --uncommitted with --untracked becomes --base=HEAD, --all becomes run-many. Project closure stays tool-native (Nx project graph; Bazel rdeps over a generated package of project and changed-file nodes, which asserts the same answer).

Affected projects (identical for every tool, asserted against Nx's own locators): the deepest project root that owns a changed file, projects whose target inputs name a changed {workspaceRoot}/ file, every project when nx.json changes, then all dependents. Package manager manifest and lock semantics (Nx diffs package.json) are Nx-only.
--projects is refused for every tool; use run-many to narrow.

operations.name: cache

summary.en: Show or clear the selected tool's local task cache, show the remote cache contract, or serve a remote cache.
summary.de: Zeigt oder leert den lokalen Task-Cache des gewählten Werkzeugs, zeigt den Remote-Cache-Vertrag oder stellt einen Remote-Cache bereit.

summary.de: Gibt einen RemoteCacheStatus aus: den Remote-Cache-Vertrag aus Build-Policy und Umgebung, wie das gewählte Werkzeug ihn umsetzt und ob der Endpunkt antwortet.

description.de: Stellt einen lokalen Remote-Cache auf 127.0.0.1:6090 bereit.

description.en: Show how Bazel uses the remote cache and whether it answers.
description.de: Zeigt, wie Bazel den Remote-Cache nutzt und ob er antwortet.

notes: status prints a CacheStatus, clear prints a CacheClear; both stop at the next checkpoint when the caller cancels and publish progress while walking or removing entries.
Nx: status walks the nx/artifacts directory of the rust cache partition, clear runs nx reset --onlyCache inside the bounded Nx namespace.

Bazel: status counts the files of the disk cache entry folders (ac and cas) of the products partition and adds the recorded build activity (builds, actions, executed, cacheHits) read from Bazel's build event stream; clear stops the persistent servers, removes their output bases (Bazel's local action cache) and empties the disk cache, so the next build is a miss; toolchains and modules stay.

The remote cache is off until SEMIO_REMOTE_CACHE_ENDPOINT names an http or https origin. SEMIO_REMOTE_CACHE_INSTANCE, _ACCESS (read-only|read-write), _UPLOAD, _COMPRESSION, _DOWNLOAD (toplevel|all), _TIMEOUT_SECONDS and _RETRIES override the defaults of the build policy; the access token is read from the variable named by SEMIO_REMOTE_CACHE_TOKEN_ENVIRONMENT (default SEMIO_REMOTE_CACHE_TOKEN) and is never written to disk.

Bazel renders the contract into --remote_cache, --remote_instance_name, --remote_upload_local_results, --remote_cache_compression, --remote_download_outputs, --remote_timeout and --remote_retries and passes the token through a credential helper. Nx renders it into its self-hosted remote cache variables (server and access token); it cannot honour compression, download mode, timeouts or retries and leaves read-only to the server's token scope. remote status prints both facts.

serve speaks Bazel's HTTP cache protocol (GET, HEAD and PUT on /ac/<sha256> and /cas/<sha256>, blobs verified against their digest) and the Nx self-hosted cache API (GET and PUT on /v1/cache/<hash>, 409 when an entry exists), each under an optional /<instance> prefix. Bearer tokens come from SEMIO_REMOTE_CACHE_SERVER_READ_TOKEN and SEMIO_REMOTE_CACHE_SERVER_WRITE_TOKEN; without a token it refuses to listen beyond loopback. The store is bounded and evicts the least recently used entries; serve publishes progress while it scans the store and stops at the next checkpoint when the caller cancels.
